Set up SQLAlchemy with an in-memory SQLite database, a User model, and a GET/POST /users CRUD using a session dependency.
code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker, Session
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

engine = create_engine("sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)
Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
app = FastAPI()

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

class UserIn(BaseModel):
    name: str

class UserOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str
    class Config:
        from_attributes = True

@app.post("/users", response_model=UserOut, status_code=201)
def create_user(payload: UserIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = User(name=payload.name)
    db.add(user); db.commit(); db.refresh(user)
    return user

@app.get("/users/{uid}", response_model=UserOut)
def get_user(uid: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.get(User, uid)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="not found")
    return user

task: Create a SQLAlchemy-backed GET /products list endpoint that returns all rows via a session dependency.
code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker, Session
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

engine = create_engine("sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
Base = declarative_base()

class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = "products"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

# seed
_s = SessionLocal()
_s.add_all([Product(name="a"), Product(name="b")])
_s.commit(); _s.close()

app = FastAPI()

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

@app.get("/products")
def products(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    return [{"id": p.id, "name": p.name} for p in db.query(Product).all()]

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker, Session
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

engine = create_engine("sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
Base = declarative_base()

class Note(Base):
    __tablename__ = "notes"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    text = Column(String)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
_s = SessionLocal(); _s.add(Note(id=1, text="hi")); _s.commit(); _s.close()

app = FastAPI()

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

@app.delete("/notes/{nid}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_note(nid: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    obj = db.get(Note, nid)
    if not obj:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="not found")
    db.delete(obj); db.commit()
    return None

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker, Session
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

engine = create_engine("sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
Base = declarative_base()

class Task(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tasks"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = Column(String)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
_s = SessionLocal(); _s.add(Task(id=1, title="old")); _s.commit(); _s.close()

app = FastAPI()

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

class TaskIn(BaseModel):
    title: str

@app.put("/tasks/{tid}")
def update_task(tid: int, payload: TaskIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    obj = db.get(Task, tid)
    if not obj:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="not found")
    obj.title = payload.title
    db.commit(); db.refresh(obj)
    return {"id": obj.id, "title": obj.title}

task: Create a SQLAlchemy endpoint that filters rows by a query parameter (case-insensitive name search).
code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker, Session
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

engine = create_engine("sqlite://", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
Base = declarative_base()

class City(Base):
    __tablename__ = "cities"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String)

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
_s = SessionLocal(); _s.add_all([City(name="London"), City(name="Lisbon"), City(name="Paris")]); _s.commit(); _s.close()

app = FastAPI()

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

@app.get("/cities")
def cities(q: str = "", db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    rows = db.query(City).filter(City.name.ilike(f"%{q}%")).all()
    return [r.name for r in rows]
